pages.title: Eyes Wide Open
pages.text: The world campaign must confirm all twelve main victories.

pages.title: Eyes Wide Open
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Open the portal under the campaign rules. Ordinary Eyes of Ender do not replace the twelve campaign eyes. This quest cannot grant victories or eyes.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Native, structure and revived encounters have distinct provenance. Rematches use canonical scaling; command spawns or unverified encounters do not replace legitimate progression.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The native addon has a separate eight-major-boss challenge; its roster is not the JEM twelve-MAIN campaign.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: The native roster has dragon, kraken, sandworm, underworld knight and yeti. JEM assigns MAIN, gatekeeper and optional roles; keep those actual roles.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Portal access requires the campaign’s twelve active special eyes. Current campaign data determines the set, not an old End Remastered acquisition list.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: A locator leads to its registered target without bypassing ritual, gatekeeper or structure requirements. Eyes come from legitimate campaign outcomes; the book does not gift eyes or signature drops.
